prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished anime ensemble illustration for Loopforge, a dark industrial robot drama. Widescreen 16:9 composition, exactly THIRTEEN different fully mechanical robots, no humans, no duplicate people. All thirteen must have visibly distinct readable heads and bodies. Preserve the approved robot designs in the reference images; exaggerate acting rather than redesigning anatomy. Image 1 is a labeled 10-worker reference board: top row bob, sam, ed, jo, gus; bottom row max, mae, kit, lou, ben. Image 2 is LIMEN's approved sheet. Image 3 is STILETTO's original sheet; apply her approved red shoulders. Image 4 is CATHEXIS's sheet. These are identity references, not the layout to reproduce. Character key:
1 bob: small slim cobalt body, tiny FLAT head under TWO oversized convex cyan fly-eye lenses that rise ABOVE and beyond the head; hands slightly big, cream chest stripe.
2 sam: blue enormous rounded humped shoulders, low forward skull with vertical grille, stout legs, heavy intake porter.
3 ed: tall angular blue goon, sweptback skull, narrow eyes, toothy exposed jaw and pointed chin, large round ear receiver, pointing index finger.
4 jo: blue work jacket and trousers, low square face under a broad projecting metal cap.
5 gus: massive SQUARE navy shoulders with pale yoke, small recessed skull, blocky boots; distinguish from sam's rounded hunched back.
6 max: slender upright blue robot, LONG NARROW straight masklike face with pale metal central nose ridge and tiny cyan horizontal eyes, narrow shoulders, ordinary hands.
7 mae: SHORT COMPACT square blue craftswoman, blunt bob-shaped angular head casing, rectangular narrow eyes, short neck, small precise hands, exposed separate legs; no dress.
8 kit: lean ribbed body, tiny squinting skull, heavy jaw, HUGE piston forearms on thin upper arms, ordinary hands, a short brass PIPE at his mouth corner.
9 lou: extremely LONG curved neck, projecting beaky skull, narrow ribcage, long thin limbs.
10 ben: SHORT SQUAT rounded barrel torso, oval hoodlike head, little square eyes, circular shoulders and thin forearms, short legs.
11 LIMEN: tall bulky pale STEEL security chief with skull grin and dark teal eye cuts, ONE cyan energy blade from right forearm, protocol clipboard optional, NO gun.
12 STILETTO: tall sleek black-chrome feminine robot with broad vivid RED shoulder/upper chest accents, RED T-shaped visor at eye level with vertical red nose line; TWO STEEL BLADE forearms, NO hands, no fingers.
13 CATHEXIS: tall theatrical ivory/brass robot lady, cracked porcelain Grace mask, amber eyes, gold crown, long pale cablehair, worn layered cream skirt and amber waistvials. No excessive wedding lace.
Ten blue workers smaller than their three supervisors; supervisors roughly 1.3–1.5 worker heights except naturally tall slim workers still subordinate in mass. Dark smoky factory backdrop, beautifully drawn machinery, expressive hand-drawn anime faces implemented as mechanical eyes, jaws and posture. Preserve steel, enamel, brass wear and material depth. No typography, no caption labels, no watermark. Design a group portrait where ALL thirteen faces can be counted. Three staggered levels: three supervisors in back, five workers in middle (sam gus ed max lou), five in foreground (jo ben mae bob kit). Each appears once.
Primary request: A ridiculous funny CLASS GRADUATION PHOTO: senior supervisors/"senpais" being bothered by their robot students. Mischievous anime ensemble comedy, exaggerated exasperated eyes, grins, tiny drawn sweat/anger symbols. LIMEN tries to hold stiff official dignity as ed proudly points and gus looms too close; STILETTO glares in exhausted annoyance, blade arms held safely away, while bob leans eagerly into the central photo with giant astonished cyan fly-eyes. CATHEXIS makes an outrageously theatrical photo pose as lou cranes his long neck into her space. sam takes up too much of the row; jo stays dry and unbothered under his cap; kit grins around his pipe; tiny severe mae is visibly unimpressed; max peeks over another shoulder with a sly look; squat ben guards his own small patch of foreground. One or two crooked graduation mortarboards perched on existing head shapes, but never hide their defining head silhouette. Chaotic yet carefully readable, warm funny chemistry. Wider framing includes full silhouettes and feet, no head cropped. Rich charcoal smoky background, controlled warm lighting, blue workers, steel LIMEN, black/red STILETTO, ivory/gold CATHEXIS.
